simple.meaning: עַרְמוֹן (ʻarmôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the plane tree (from its smooth and shed bark).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 30:37. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַרְמוֹן (H6196) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
